title: site.config.json
description: Everything specific to one site. The map, the CMS, the seed and scripts/fetch_osm.py read it.

name.description: Site name as visitors see it, e.g. "EkoCheras Mall"

logo.description: Logo path under public/, used on the page, the admin and the building signs

timezone.description: IANA time zone for opening hours and day/night, e.g. "Asia/Taipei"

locales.description: Languages, in the order of the language buttons; the first is the default. Changing them needs a new database migration.

radius.description: Metres of city around the origin to fetch and draw (600–1200 is typical)

skyline.description: Optional: metres out to which tall buildings (skyline landmarks) are fetched too, beyond radius

skylineMin.description: Optional: the height in metres a building needs to count for skyline (default 150)

origin.description: Centre of the map (usually the main building) for scripts/fetch_osm.py

osmName.description: The main building's name in OpenStreetMap; if missing, the largest building at the origin

label.description: The highlighted label on the main building: a name, or one per language, e.g. {"en": "…", "zh": "…"}

signFacade.description: Two corners [[x,y],[x,y]] (metres from the origin) of the facade with the main sign; else the longest facade

roofLabel.description: Show a 'Green roof' label on the roof

style.description: How the main building's walls are drawn: "mall" (default, the EkoCheras facade) or "tower" (curtain-wall high-rise, see tower)

view.description: Compass bearing (degrees) the opening view looks from; default 139 (south-east)

footprint.description: Draw the main building from its published floor plan instead of the OSM outline: a rounded rectangle w × d metres, corner radius r, long side facing `facing` degrees, centred on the OSM outline (+ optional shift [x, y])

tower.description: style "tower": floorHeight (m), podium height (m), crown height (m), glass and fin colours, bands = [[from, to], …] heights of the lit amenity floors

highlight.description: Colour of the main building's outline, crown ribbon and pulse ring (default: magenta by day, orange by night)

routes.description: Up to two route ids offered on the main building's card

halo.description: A soft light around the main building: day and night colours, size (× the building's height)

pulseRadius.description: Radius (m) of the pulsing ring on the ground around the main building (default 1.45 × its size)

pulseThrough.description: 0–1: strength of a faint copy of the ground ring drawn through buildings (for a tower among towers)

road.description: OpenStreetMap name of the main road driving routes start on

roadType.description: Its highway type, e.g. trunk, primary

starts.description: Driving start choices in the CMS (stored values; changing them needs a migration)

hideRoadLabels.description: Road names not to label (e.g. a private link road)

aboutFacts.description: Up to four big figures in the About popup

text.description: Per-language wording that is the site's own

loading.description: Line under the logo while the map loads

why.description: Heading of the highlights in the Visit tab

agree.description: Contact form consent; {name} is the site name

floors.description: Floor names by floor code, e.g. {"B1": "地下一樓"}

ui.description: Any other interface wording by key in src/map/i18n.js (e.g. stores, tabStores, searchStores with {n}); for a residence or campus instead of a mall

seo.description: Defaults for the SEO settings on first setup (editable in the admin afterwards)

sampleStore.description: Store the browser sweep searches for and shares

liveUrl.description: Live address the browser sweep checks by default (BASE_URL overrides)

floors.description: Floors stores can be on, bottom to top. code is stored with each store (changing codes needs a migration); z is the pin height in metres; short is how the store list shows it (e.g. L1, B1, 2F); admin is the name in the CMS menu.

categories.description: The site's own categories for the directory (replaces the mall ones: food, fashion, …); value is stored with each item (changing values needs a migration), label per language

landmarks.description: Big named labels over landmarks: label text and the point [x, y] (metres from the origin, from osm.json) of the building or part it stands on

aboutImage.description: Picture at the top of the About popup: src under public/ and alt text

names.description: Label names to correct, by the English (OSM) name: {"zh": "…"} sets the Chinese name, {"zh": null} keeps English when OSM's Chinese name is doubtful

look.description: Tints of the 3D scene: horizonDay, horizonNight (sky at the horizon), fogDay, fogNight (haze); skyNight multiplies the night sky picture

vividGreen.description: Parks, lawns and trees keep their full green by day

routeColors.description: Route colours by route id (ribbon on the map and the button icon), e.g. {"bus": "#8FB8E8"}

storeRoute.description: false: the store card has no route button (homes in a tower have no door of their own)

litLandmarks.description: Landmarks drawn in their real night lighting and never faded: every building or part whose centre is within r metres of at [x, y] and at least minH metres tall

tours.description: Units with a 3D walk-through (src/tour): id (for #tour=id links), store (its name in the directory), level, unitFrom (metres from the tower's centre along the facade where the unit starts)
